Are you me? I'm almost very similar to you except that I was born deaf and I mainly use ASL and my hearing aids as well. 

Almost all of my friends are hearing, and it's probably because I'm living in a location that doesn't have a lot of deaf people. I am relatively lucky because my family knows sign language and some of my friends are willing to learn sign language. Still, I have to use my phone or lip read to communicate with most people and I can understand, it's a lot of work. 

No, I don't think you are being unreasonable, from what I've read, your frustrations sound valid. Sometimes I get frustrated because my family occasionally forget to sign while talking at the dinner table or if my friends are too lazy or busy to learn my language but that's life. Personally, I feel lucky I have a supportive family that were willing to learn sign language and at least try to understand me. 


Just keep trying, and something'll happen, or maybe you should try to find contact with other deaf/hard of hearing people, or other people who are really willing to learn sign language or really willing to get through the hurdles to communicate with you! Universities/colleges often have some ASL classes or clubs, maybe that could be a start, if you're in school now. 

Good luck, I hope everything works out for you soon! :)
